feature: gRPC xds_wrr_locality_experimental policy and resolver weight updates

behavior.configuration: required childPolicy selects the first supported recursive policy; xds_wrr_locality remains in the parsed tree and lowers to an owned weighted_target runtime snapshot at channel setup/update
behavior.metadata: all ChannelEndpoint and custom connector variants expose locality_weight separately from ring_hash_weight; the next hierarchical_path element after parent policy path identifies the locality
behavior.weights: matches grpc-core named positive locality extraction, first positive weight on conflicts and sorted target order; missing/zero-only localities produce no generated target
behavior.address_resolution: ordinary and shared host-to-IP promotion retain the endpoint locality path and weight
behavior.updates: canonical resolver inventory regenerates target weights when service-config JSON stays the same; matching sources/workers keep the existing transport, removed locality children use bounded retention and restored children reuse their transports
behavior.active_calls: an admitted RPC completes on its old locality after removal while new RPCs use the remaining locality
behavior.priority: unchanged priority failover clock, activation and deactivation state survives resolver-only locality snapshot regeneration
behavior.ownership: temporary expansion arena is released after the recursive runtime retains its own config/path data; allocation failure leaves no candidate published
behavior.structure: cohesive service-config validation and locality expansion modules with adjacent pure and socket tests

locality_debug.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC xDS locality' --summary all

regressions: required/supported child policy and malformed/deep recursive input
first positive conflicting locality weights, sorted names and missing/zero locality handling
nested priority and weighted-target path isolation
parsed config and expansion allocation failure cleanup
ordinary locality 1:3 distribution plus child round-robin
shared target-only 1:3 to 3:1 update with original source/worker pointers
zero-weight locality removal and restoration with original connections
in-flight RPC completion after locality removal
unchanged priority activation/deactivation and failover clocks after generated target replacement

ordinary hostname init begins with zero resolved slots; locality derives from canonical target before lazy DNS/address promotion, parsed config may be destroyed, and the first real RPC succeeds with retained locality metadata

references.roles: grpc-core source defines first-positive/default-zero rules; official grpc-js-xds executes positive-weight config generation; official grpc-js servers independently count complete native RPCs and exact transport sessions

remaining_scope: ADS discovery, cluster implementation/manager and remaining xDS control plane, plus broader cross-protocol best-in-class evidence remain open.
